name: horstoeko/invoicesuite
description: Extensible PHP library for creating, reading and validating electronic invoices such as XRechnung, ZUGFeRD and Factur-X, with support for custom formats.

suggest.smalot/pdfparser: A PDF parser under LGPL license (used in InvoiceSuitePdfExtractor)

rector:dryrun:xd: @php -d xdebug.mode=off -d realpath_cache_size=64M -d realpath_cache_ttl=600 -d opcache.enable_cli=1 -d opcache.file_cache_only=0 -d opcache.file_cache= vendor/bin/rector process --config build/phprectorconfig.php --dry-run
rector:run:xd: @php -d xdebug.mode=off -d realpath_cache_size=64M -d realpath_cache_ttl=600 -d opcache.enable_cli=1 -d opcache.file_cache_only=0 -d opcache.file_cache= vendor/bin/rector process --config build/phprectorconfig.php
